test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 26 Oct, 2023)
subject: general
question: What is the single discount equivalent to the successive discounts of 20%, 35%, and 10%?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net Multiplier = (1 − 0.20) × (1 − 0.35) × (1 − 0.10)

Net Multiplier = 0.8 × 0.65 × 0.9 = 0.468

Equivalent Discount = (1 − 0.468) × 100 = 53.2%

**∴ The correct answer is 53.2%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First discount (d₁) = 20%

Second discount (d₂) = 35%

Third discount (d₃) = 10%

**Formula Used:**

Successive discount of x% and y% = [x + y − (x × y)/100]%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43a42f4eb624c5fdd302ac0b5a85836b07f73d81f0e3b5b3cab7c4ba19ab432f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Equivalent discount for 20% and 35%:

⇒ D₁₂ = 20 + 35 − (20 × 35)/100

⇒ D₁₂ = 55 − 7 = 48%

⇒ Now, equivalent discount for 48% and 10%:

⇒ Net Discount = 48 + 10 − (48 × 10)/100

⇒ Net Discount = 58 − 4.8

⇒ Net Discount = 53.2%

**∴ The correct answer is 53.2%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Formula

For two successive discounts a% and b%, the single equivalent discount is (a + b − ab/100)%.

Relation between MP and SP

Selling Price (SP) = Marked Price (MP) × (100 − d₁)/100 × (100 − d₂)/100 × ...

Effective Percentage Change

This method can also be used for successive population increases or area changes where x and y are positive for increase and negative for decrease.</p
